entries.note: This manifest itself: versioned, schema-shaped, and validated like every other data file.
The nine-worlds role definitions as data (Y-012): hats, ceilings and expected capabilities.
The mesh's named enemies as data (Y-010); SIMULATED paperwork - it names controls, it does not claim them built.
Licence & provenance register (Y-018): every noticed piece of the project — licence, founding documents, dependencies, standards — with its origin and licence; vendored is false throughout.

The campaign file (Y-019): the build roadmap as machine data — 11 parts, 244 slices — generated from docs/YGGDRASIL_BUILD_ROADMAP_2026-10-30.md and drift-checked against it; banking state lives in CAMPAIGN_STATE.md, never here.
The Pi citizen profile (Y-033): Mimir-class ARM requirements, the Pi governor policy, and the coexistence rules for Samtal, Aurelia, the kiosk, and the Hailo device — as data.

The laptop citizen profile (Y-034): purplelongship-class x86 + CUDA requirements (required accelerator and minimum VRAM as data), the laptop governor policy, and the coexistence rules for the user's own desktop session and the NVIDIA device — as data.

The VM citizen profile (Y-035): this VM as a CPU-only node — x86 requirements, the VM governor policy, the host reserve, and the coexistence rules for the host daemon and the (absent) thermal sensor — as data. A CPU-only profile: it names no required accelerator and no VRAM floor.

The phone citizen profile (Y-036): phone-class ARM requirements, the phone governor policy, the small-model ceiling and the battery governor policy as data, and the coexistence rules for the phone OS and the cellular radio — as data. Built and SIMULATED only: on-device proof is NOT PROVEN until a phone runs it.

note: Data discipline (Y-016): every registry, catalog, profile and policy in this repo is a versioned data file registered here, with its schema and its validator. A data file that is not registered here fails validation; a registered file whose on-disk version, roadmap slice or items disagree with this manifest fails validation. The manifest registers itself first. Profiles and policies do not exist as data yet - the first one lands by adding its entry here, in the same slice that creates it.
